steps.d: Upload an approved face-and-shoulders photo with even light and nothing covering the face. Confirm the person agreed to this business use before you upload.

maker.upload_title: Drop a photo of the person here

faq.q: What is an AI team headshot?
faq.a: A square portrait from an approved photo, with a backdrop, crop, and light you can reuse for every teammate. Each person keeps their own features. It is not an official identity document.
A recent face-and-shoulders photo with even light, and no hat, sunglasses, or hand covering the face. Use a photo that person has approved for the company to upload.

faq.q: How can the team page feel consistent?
faq.a: Share one backdrop, one crop, and one light across every portrait, while each person keeps their own features. Write that setup once and reuse it, including as a batch.

faq.q: Can I put names inside the headshot?
faq.a: Add names and job titles as text beside each image. Keeping them out of the portrait makes a role change a text edit, not a new generation. A caption belongs on a short intro clip, not inside the still.

faq.q: Will this match a specific person exactly?
faq.a: No. It follows the features visible in the uploaded photo, and it is still a generated portrait, not an official identity document. Have that person review it before you publish.

faq.q: What does a team headshot cost?
faq.a: Each photo costs 24 credits, the cost is shown before you start, and a failed job returns those credits. The download has no watermark, and you can use it in your own ads, pages, and posts. Plan sizes are listed on [AIVideosUGC pricing](page:pricing).

faq.q: Do I need permission from each teammate?
faq.a: Yes. Upload only a photo the person agreed you can use for this business purpose, and let them approve the final portrait.

faq.q: Can a new hire match an existing set?
faq.a: Yes. Reuse the same backdrop, crop, and light on the new hire's approved photo. You do not reshoot the rest of the team.

faq.q: Can I use the portraits in a pitch deck?
faq.a: Yes. The square file can sit on an About page, a profile, or a slide. Keep contact details as text next to the image.

faq.q: Can a short intro have a voice, captions, and music?
faq.a: Yes. Keep the portraits as stills, and add an AI voice, captions, and a music bed on a short intro clip beside them. You can post that clip to TikTok or Meta, or download it. The portrait is not a customer quote.

faq.q: Can I run the team through the API?
faq.a: Yes. Send approved photos through the API when a directory needs the same crop. Each photo still needs that person's permission, and each job shows its credit cost first.
